STAFF REPORT 
CITY OF OCEANSIDE 
DATE: 
March 13, 2024 
TO: 
Honorable Mayor and City Councilmembers 
FROM: 
Police Department 
SUBJECT: 
INTRODUCTION OF AN ORDINANCE TO THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE 
CITY OF OCEANSIDE AMENDING CHAPTER 5 - BICYCLES TO 
INCLUDE THE OPERATION OF REGULATED MOBILITY DEVICES 
SYNOPSIS 
Staff recommends that the City Council introduce an Ordinance to amend Chapter 5 of 
the Oceanside City Code to align the City Code with changes in laws, regulations, and 
best practices concerning the operation of regulated mobility devices (including e-bikes) 
within the City limits.
